reason_for_supersession: Audit of Code-06 and Code-07 showed that the 8,210 strict GB1 cubes are overlapping WT-anchored hypercubes generated from crossed amino-acid alternative identities at positions 39, 40, 41, and 54. Individual cube rows therefore do not constitute independent biological sampling units. The previously frozen independent-cube bootstrap could underestimate uncertainty through pseudoreplication.

evidence_from_pipeline.cube_definition: Each cube is defined by one non-WT alternative amino-acid identity at each of the four GB1 positions and contains the 16 WT/alternative combinatorial vertices.
evidence_from_pipeline.shared_structure: All cubes share WT; cubes sharing one or more alternative identities can also share non-WT vertices.

estimator_partition_contract.note: The corrected IID split remains the MINE train/validation/test estimator partition. Dependence-aware biological resampling must not revert the estimator to the earlier AA-identity-strict OOD protocol.

interpretation_boundary: Inference is conditional on the GB1 four-site landscape and its observed amino-acid identity structure. It does not by itself establish a universal population-level claim about all protein positions or all protein foundation models.
